title: pyriet and glyriet
description: a mod that adds pyriet and glyriet to the game! also a bunch of other stuff.
body:
This is the first mod I made. It is still full of bugs, errors, and glitches. It is mainly made for Creative mode, but does have some Survival support. I suggest not looking at my code, yes it is that bad (you can view it at your own risk).

**I hope you enjoy playing! :D**

# Info
this mod adds glyriet and pyriet to the game.
Glyriet can be used for food and tech (like the glyriet radio and glyriet smoke machine)
Pyriet is mainly used for a toolset and armor set.
the pyriet toolset is the best toolset in the game, you can break 3x3x1 areas with most of the tools!
Pyriet food is really OP.
There are also dashes (which can be used to dash, of course)
and a pyriet gambling machine (which has a small chance to crash your game when you gamble)
Pyriet grass is a block that looks like grass from the top, but when you walk over it, it explodes!

You should definitely download it if you like to troll friends or just experiment with random stuff yourself!

# DISCLAIMER
**Gambling:**
Remember, don't gamble irl
In-game gambling is at your own risk!

**Copyright:**
If you notice any of your work or other material used in a way you do not approve of, or that I cannot use, please contact me so I can remove it or change it.

**Songs:**
There is an item in the mod called the Glyriet radio. It uses songs that I downloaded from the internet. I am not sure if that is completely copyright compliant. I chose this because I did not want to use AI generated music, which was the only other option I found for decently good tracks. The songs also contain text and language not suitable for all ages, so **by using my mod you confirm you are over the age of 18**.

**AI use:**
Some AI was used to help me understand things. Almost no AI was used for the mod code. There are a few small exceptions, for example, my Blockbench did not have a Java class generator for the entity models, so I used AI for that.

**Textures:**
Almost all textures were made by me, so they may not be the best.
